claims.title: Adjacent-port noisy online FIFO: full mixed labelled-record law with finite reuse

quoted_fields.interface: A classical3D CTMC on2L^2 sites, corresponding input/output ports at unit separation on opposite faces of an LxLx2 slab. Every module has(B,M) in{empty,0,1}x{0,1}; all stored fields are faultable. Independent unit-rate binary arrivals have arbitrary causal payloads; capture/read coins have error delta. Fixed nominal service proposals at rate mu emit occupied B xor M xor Z and ALWAYS reset(B,M)=(empty,0). Independent bounded-local-template fault proposals have per-site intensity<=epsilon and arbitrary history-adapted classical local STATE maps. Nominal proposal generator/rules remain fixed, as in the issued model. Product initialization has stipulated independent epsilon-bounded reset errors. Semantic input/output event labels and matching origins exist only in analysis, never reliable runtime registers.
